resource.title: [Jules Task 4] CDP Scraper & Vision OCR Resiliency Suite
resource.prompt:
Create comprehensive resilience unit and stress tests in tests/ for the Zero-Touch CDP scraper and Gemini Vision OCR pipeline:
1. Test scripts/lib/ocr_service.js: payload size limits (25MB), simulated 429 rate limit backoff, malformed base64 handling, and fallback table extraction.
2. Test scripts/lib/cdp.js and scripts/lib/dom_extract.js: connection timeouts, table deduplication heuristics, and scrolling thresholds.
Ensure all new tests pass and integrate cleanly into npm run test:all.

gitPatch.suggestedCommitMessage:
test: add resilience unit and stress tests for CDP and OCR pipelines

Adds comprehensive tests for `scripts/lib/ocr_service.js` covering payload limits, rate limits, and base64 handling.
Adds comprehensive tests for `scripts/lib/cdp.js` and `scripts/lib/dom_extract.js` covering connection timeouts, scrolling thresholds, and table deduplication.
Updates `npm run test:all` in `package.json` to include these new resilience test suites.
Fixes chaos test flakiness due to unexpected fallback assertion behavior.
